bends.note: turns SSW off the straight run from West 8th
back to near-south just above Bassett Road
turns SW (fork with the unnamed 40 ft street going on south)
40 ft street from the Fairbanks fork turns SW (printed only 'ST.')
gentle curve: SSW from Bassett, then bending to SSE toward Moulton

ends.note: ends at Mount Echo Park south of Beaumont Place

notes: Fairbanks Avenue printed 'AVENUE' at the north end and 'FAIRBANKS' further south; same street, bends SW at the Bassett estate and again at y~4700 where an unnamed 40 ft street ('ST.' only, pick at 8795,4700 is that Y-fork) continues south then SW toward Steiner. Nonpareil Street is printed 'STREET' north of Pica and 'NONPAREIL' south of Pica; treated as one street (slight jog). Crestline Street: printed 'STREET' on the diagonal leaving Bassett Road and 'CRESTLINE' south of Pica; lines continuous, treated as one street, suffix taken from the north label. Elberon Avenue printed 'AVENUE' at the top and 'ELBERON' near y 4000; east side is the plate edge, double lines inside it (tracks?). Two street stubs leave Elberon eastward off the plate: y~1068 (label cut, '6" ... P', probably a pipe label) and y~3696 (label starts 'C'), both recorded as '?'. West 8th Street printed 'STREET' with 'VIADUCT' in the roadway; Fairbanks, Woodlawn and Elberon all have stubs north of it. Bassett Road ends at Fairbanks on the west (only a sewer line beyond). Pica Street runs only between Nonpareil and Crestline.
